# Technical words for helpers/abbreviations.py: whole words of computing and hardware that the
# English list (helpers/english_words.txt) lacks. One lowercase word per line, sorted; a word
# belongs here when engineers write and say it whole, not when it shortens a longer word (that
# goes to `[accepted]` in helpers/naming_words.toml, with its reason).
